reviews.comment: Dude is absolutely hilarious. Will make sure he gives you feedback and cares for his students. He wants to see you succeed and will give you book recommendations as well. He was a light in my semester! Prof. Jeon is the best

Genuinely one of the most caring and best professors I have had thus far. He is an international grad student from South Korea but he is one of the most intelligent and knowledgeable professors I have ever had. His course material is interesting and you know what is expected out of you. 10/10 professor. You won't regret taking him!

Last fall semester, I had the pleasure of having Mr. Soohyun Jeon as my English professor. For his first time teaching, he did a remarkable job--very compassionate in helping students and ensuring they participate in class. 8 weekly discussions (15%), 6 rough drafts (20%), 2 analysis essays (35%), 1 group project (10%), and 1 final draft (20%).
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
